rationale: Addresses cluster [validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet] task t05-collection. Although validate reported success, the failure indicates false‑negative validation: a rule likely missing from the cheat‑sheet (and possibly from the validator) led to an undetected error. Clarifying mandatory requirements—particularly for provenance—closes the coverage gap.
expected_effect: Users will now see rule E0 as a mandated part of the pack contract. Combined with the workflow update, this prevents extraction outputs that lack provenance. The false‑negative validation scenario (t05) is addressed by making the requirement explicit.
regression_risk: Minimal. The validator already checks provenance‑related constraints (E14/E15); this simply adds a missing top‑level expectation. Previously passing tasks already satisfy this rule, so no disruption to existing behaviour.
